label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Resend to Non-Openers
body: Give your message a second chance to reach interested subscribers by sending it again with a fresh subject line a few days later.
caption:
Not everyone sees your first email. In a busy inbox, some simply get missed. A gentle resend to those who didn't open the first time can boost your reach without overwhelming active subscribers. Just tweak the subject line a little for a fresh look. It's a smart way to maximize the effort you put into your content. Try it next time you send an important update!
